notes.title: Build Update!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for playing Billiards Dungeon! We have listened to your feedback, and are thrilled to release our first update! Below is a list of additions and overall changes.

Additions

Added item tracker and stats sheet to the pause menu. Both can be disabled/enabled in the main options menu.
New map graphic


Changes 

Updated main options menu
Tweaked coin drop rates
Scaled shop prices
Fixed slowdown/freezes on the final floors
Fixed exit not spawning
Fixed spikes with mismatched colliders
Fixed Golems dying to status effects
Fixed restarting run reverting to knight
Fixed fade not working
Fixed Item Sprites going into the ground
Fixed texture bug when above walls in the Dungeon
Corrected UI Scaling
